question: At what Śaka-era reckoning does the foretold rule in Kāmarūpa begin?
premises: A chronogram is given as kumārī-candra-kāli-indu.
The reckoning is in the Śaka era.
This marks the time of subsequent events.
inference: The subsequent events are dated to the Śaka year indicated by the chronogram.
uncertainties: The numerical value of the chronogram is not decoded here.
plain_english: O great goddess, when the Śaka era reached the year marked by maiden, moon, and Kālī...
